name: in_lane
description: The album sits in a map lane; qualifier primary or secondary.

name: lane_parent
description: A lane descends from a parent lane in the same map.

name: has_genre
description: A genre the album or artist carries; qualifier votes or vocabulary.

name: from_scene
description: The album or artist belongs to a scene: a place, a period and a circle of people.

name: based_in
description: The artist is based in an area; qualifiers from and to.

name: recorded_at
description: The album was recorded at a place or in an area; qualifier dates.

name: member_of
description: A person is or was a member of a group; qualifiers from, to, instrument.

name: credited_on
description: A person is credited on an album or recording; qualifier role (producer, engineer, pedal steel, songwriter, ...).

name: released_by
description: The album was released by a label; qualifiers year, catalog.

name: influenced_by
description: The newer album or artist was influenced by the older one; documented or reported only.

name: sounds_like
description: The newer album sounds like the older album or artist; always inferred.

name: covers
description: The newer recording or album covers the older work, recording or album.

name: samples
description: The newer recording samples the older one.

name: associated_with
description: Two artists worked, played or recorded together; stored once with the lower entity id as subject; qualifier kind (collaborator, bandmate, backing). Touring alone is toured_with.

name: toured_with
description: Two artists toured or shared bills as separate acts (opened for, supported, co-headlined); stored once with the lower entity id as subject; qualifiers role, year.

name: performs_as
description: A person records or performs under a stage name or solo project (Katie Crutchfield performs as Waxahatchee).

name: renamed_from
description: A group or project was earlier known by another name (Crazy Horse renamed from The Rockets); the newer name is the subject.

name: interpolates
description: The newer recording borrows the melody or lyric of an older song (interpolation, adaptation); qualifier track.

name: path_next
description: The next album on a map's listening path; qualifiers path, step.

name: has_tag
description: The album carries a tag (instrument, voice, guitar, writing, mood, production, function, context).

name: on_list
description: The album is on a list; qualifiers position, priority.
